ui_and_tools.title: UI and Tools
ui_and_tools.description: Provides core user interface components and implements specific tool functionalities, such as the color palette display.

tool_panel.title: Tool Panel Module
tool_panel.description: Manages the display and interaction logic for specific tools, including handling tool-related events and rendering their outputs.

tool_panel_component.title: Tool Panel Component
tool_panel_component.description: Manages the main UI and logic for the color palette tool, including session state and event handling based on session events.

function_call_output_display.title: Function Call Output Display
function_call_output_display.description: Renders the visual output of tool function calls, specifically parsing and displaying color palettes.

core_ui_components.title: Core UI Components
core_ui_components.description: Provides fundamental UI elements and the main application entry points for client and server-side rendering.

page_rendering.title: Page Rendering
page_rendering.description: Handles the initial rendering of client-side pages and server-side rendering processes.

basic_ui_elements.title: Basic UI Elements
basic_ui_elements.description: Provides fundamental user interface components, such as reusable buttons.

event_and_messaging.title: Event and Messaging
event_and_messaging.description: Handles the sending of user messages and client events, as well as logging and displaying all incoming and outgoing communication events.

event_logging_and_display.title: Event Logging and Display
event_logging_and_display.description: Handles the recording and visual presentation of system events in a user-friendly log.

event_display_components.title: Event Display Components
event_display_components.description: Manages the display of individual events and the overall event log within the UI.

event_dispatching.title: Event Dispatching
event_dispatching.description: Manages the sending of various client-side events, including user messages, to the backend system.

event_transport_and_logging.title: Event Transport and Logging
event_transport_and_logging.description: Manages the low-level transmission of client events over the data channel and updates the local event log.

event_creation.title: Event Creation
event_creation.description: Handles the construction and initiation of various client-side events, such as user messages.

session_management.title: Session Management
session_management.description: Manages the lifecycle of real-time communication sessions, including starting, stopping, and handling session state.

session_ui_controls.title: Session UI Controls
session_ui_controls.description: Provides the user interface components for initiating, monitoring, and terminating a session, adapting based on the current session status.

session_control_management.title: Session Control Management
session_control_management.description: Manages the overall session control logic, dynamically rendering the appropriate session state view and handling the core actions like starting and stopping sessions.

session_state_views.title: Session State Views
session_state_views.description: Contains UI components that represent the active or inactive state of a user session, allowing users to initiate or terminate sessions and interact.

session_core.title: Session Core Logic
session_core.description: Manages the fundamental operations for starting and stopping a communication session, including WebRTC peer connections and data channels.

session_lifecycle.title: Session Lifecycle Management
session_lifecycle.description: Manages the initiation and termination of client sessions, including WebRTC peer connection setup and teardown.

application_session_integration.title: Application Session Integration
application_session_integration.description: Integrates session management functionalities into the main application, managing global session state and coordinating with UI controls.
